faq.a: Yes. The Matrix Head Spa + Hydrating Glow Facial combines scalp care with a mini facial and facial massage. The current menu also includes men's scalp-and-facial combinations. Check the booking menu for the experience and appointment length you prefer.
faq.q: Can I combine a facial and Head Spa?

faq.a: Head Spa services leave hair wet. Luxury Blowout Styling is a separate add-on appointment with a cosmetologist, when available. Reserve it with your visit if you would like your hair professionally dried and styled.
faq.q: Is hair drying included with Head Spa?

faq.a: Visit Matrix Massage & Bodywork at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. Book online through our current Square menu or text 262-939-9325. Our Salem studio welcomes guests from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Kenosha, and nearby Antioch, Illinois.
